(rule!
 ;; Two disconnected figures share an outline color. One is a colored guide;
 ;; the other is an uncolored target whose enclosed cavities may be deformed.
 ;; Isolate each 8-connected figure before cropping (their bounding boxes can
 ;; overlap). Extract its four-connected enclosed non-outline regions. Match
 ;; regions in spatial order: bounding-box center row, then center column.
 ;; Transfer each guide region's color to the corresponding target cavity;
 ;; preserve the target outline and exterior, returning its tight bounding box.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define bg (mode g -1))
   (define figures (objects-multicolor g bg))
   (define (colors obj)
    (remove-duplicates (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p))) (obj-cells obj))))
   (define target-object (first (filter (lambda (o) (= (length (colors o)) 1)) figures)))
   (define guide-object (first (filter (lambda (o) (> (length (colors o)) 1)) figures)))
   (define wall (first (colors target-object)))
   (define (isolated-crop obj)
    (build-grid (obj-h obj) (obj-w obj) (r c)
     (let ((p (list (+ (obj-r1 obj) r) (+ (obj-c1 obj) c))))
      (if (member p (obj-cells obj)) (at g (first p) (second p)) bg))))
   (define guide (isolated-crop guide-object))
   (define target (isolated-crop target-object))
   (define (region<? a b)
    (let* ((aa (bbox-of-cells a)) (bb (bbox-of-cells b))
           (ay (+ (first aa) (third aa))) (by (+ (first bb) (third bb)))
           (ax (+ (second aa) (fourth aa))) (bx (+ (second bb) (fourth bb))))
     (if (= ay by) (< ax bx) (< ay by))))
   (define (cavities canvas)
    (sort
     (filter
      (lambda (cells)
       (andmap (lambda (p) (and (> (first p) 0) (> (second p) 0)
                                (< (first p) (- (rows canvas) 1))
                                (< (second p) (- (cols canvas) 1)))) cells))
      (find-0-regions (cellmap canvas (r c v) (if (= v wall) wall bg)) bg))
     region<?))
   (define guide-regions (cavities guide))
   (define target-regions (cavities target))
   ;; Parallel clauses deliberately zip the already matched region lists.
   (for/fold ((out target)) ((source-region guide-regions) (target-region target-regions))
    (let ()
     (define paint? #t)
     (define color (at guide (first (first source-region)) (second (first source-region))))
     (if paint? (recolor-cells out target-region color) out))))))

(rule!
 ;; A blank outline and a colored exemplar contain corresponding compartments.
 ;; Isolate the two figures before cropping: bounding boxes can overlap without
 ;; the figures touching. Find four-connected non-outline regions enclosed by
 ;; each outline. Match left, center and right regions in top-to-bottom order,
 ;; independent of their different areas, contours and vertical spacing. Return
 ;; only the blank figure's tight crop, filled with the matched exemplar colors.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define reverse-order? #t)
   (define bg (mode g -1))
   (define figures (objects-multicolor g bg))
   (define (palette o)
    (remove-duplicates (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p))) (obj-cells o))))
   (define target-object (first (filter (lambda (o) (= (length (palette o)) 1)) figures)))
   (define source-object (first (filter (lambda (o) (not (equal? o target-object))) figures)))
   (define outline (first (palette target-object)))
   (define (isolate o)
    (paint-cells (empty-grid (obj-h o) (obj-w o) bg)
     (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) (obj-r1 o)) (- (second p) (obj-c1 o))
                            (at g (first p) (second p)))) (obj-cells o))))
   (define target (isolate target-object))
   (define source (isolate source-object))
   (define (holes crop)
    (filter
     (lambda (o) (and (> (obj-r1 o) 0) (> (obj-c1 o) 0)
                      (< (obj-r2 o) (- (rows crop) 1)) (< (obj-c2 o) (- (cols crop) 1))))
     (objects (cellmap crop (r c v) (if (= v outline) 0 1)) 0)))
   (define (side o crop)
    (let ((offset (- (* 2 (apply + (map second (obj-cells o))))
                     (* (- (cols crop) 1) (obj-size o)))))
     (cond ((< offset 0) -1) ((> offset 0) 1) (else 0))))
   (define (ordered crop reverse?)
    (sort (holes crop)
     (lambda (a b)
      (let ((sa (side a crop)) (sb (side b crop)))
       (or (< sa sb)
           (and (= sa sb)
                (if (= (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b))
                    (< (obj-c1 a) (obj-c1 b))
                    (if reverse? (> (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b)) (< (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b))))))))))
   (define target-regions (ordered target #f))
   (define source-regions (ordered source reverse-order?))
   (for/fold ((out target)) ((t target-regions) (s source-regions))
    (let ((p (first (obj-cells s))))
     (recolor-cells out (obj-cells t) (at source (first p) (second p))))))))
